feeding_claim.verbatim: We specialize in offering nutritious grass-fed Katahdin lamb, pastured chicken and eggs,

farmers_markets: Barkhamsted farmers market, Highway Garage on Route 44 (Saturdays, May to September)
resold_note: Also sells sweet corn from Gresczyk Farms.
notes: Self-serve farm stand open daily 9 to 7, cash or Venmo; custom or larger orders by contact form. Pork is raised in hardwood forest; chickens are free-range and get non-GMO grain, so only the lamb is described as grass-fed and finishing is not stated. Site says it holds A Greener World certifications (Animal Welfare Approved, grass-fed, Non-GMO), but the farm was not found on the AGW listing, so no certification added; Verifier to check. About page may mention beef; not confirmed as a product. No phone, delivery or shipping stated.
